standard: BANA Nemeth Braille Code for Mathematics and Science Notation 2022
scope: Loaded Electron workflows only. A verified row has both creation and MathJax-navigated editing evidence; unit/SRE/MathCAT fixtures do not substitute for it.

families.creationTest: new equations use the same empty Nemeth replacement draft and commit once
families.editingTest: MathJax-focused Nemeth editing replaces only the selected subtree with an atomic code

families.creationTest: Nemeth fraction creation and MathJax numerator navigation edit preserve the denominator
families.editingTest: Nemeth fraction creation and MathJax numerator navigation edit preserve the denominator

families.creationTest: renderer creates a nested script and radical through compositional Nemeth cells
families.editingTest: MathJax navigation edits a nested Nemeth subexpression without widening the target

families.creationTest: Nemeth left-subscript choice creates multiscripts and MathJax edits the owned base
families.editingTest: Nemeth left-subscript choice creates multiscripts and MathJax edits the owned base

families.creationTest: Nemeth typeform scope creation and MathJax inner editing preserve the bold MathML scope
families.editingTest: Nemeth typeform scope creation and MathJax inner editing preserve the bold MathML scope

families.creationTest: Nemeth comparison creation and MathJax relation navigation edit preserve both operands
families.editingTest: Nemeth comparison creation and MathJax relation navigation edit preserve both operands

families.creationTest: renderer applies immediate, structural-followup, and atomic Nemeth codes in one real draft
families.editingTest: MathJax-focused Nemeth editing replaces only the selected subtree with an atomic code

families.creationTest: six-key input feeds the same Nemeth draft transition as Unicode cells
families.editingTest: six-key input feeds the same Nemeth draft transition as Unicode cells
families.editingGesture: same test repeats a six-key chord after MathJax ArrowDown and E

families.creationTest: Nemeth modifier creation and MathJax base navigation edit preserve the overbar scope
families.editingTest: Nemeth modifier creation and MathJax base navigation edit preserve the overbar scope

families.creationTest: Nemeth function creation and MathJax argument navigation edit preserve application structure
families.editingTest: Nemeth function creation and MathJax argument navigation edit preserve application structure

families.creationTest: Nemeth integral creation and MathJax sign navigation edit preserve the local follow-up structure
families.editingTest: Nemeth integral creation and MathJax sign navigation edit preserve the local follow-up structure

families.creationTest: Nemeth integral bounds are created locally and MathJax navigation edits only the selected bound
families.editingTest: Nemeth integral bounds are created locally and MathJax navigation edits only the selected bound

families.creationTest: Nemeth degree decoration is created as one local code and MathJax edits its base only
families.editingTest: Nemeth degree decoration is created as one local code and MathJax edits its base only

families.creationTest: Nemeth geometry atom creation and MathJax whole-scope editing preserve the local code
families.editingTest: Nemeth geometry atom creation and MathJax whole-scope editing preserve the local code

families.creationTest: Nemeth cancellation owns its content and MathJax edits only the canceled term
families.editingTest: Nemeth cancellation owns its content and MathJax edits only the canceled term

families.gap: Rule 25 spatial arrangements and chemistry are outside this release scope.
